name: datasub_provider_automatic_routing_control
statements: create or replace function public.set_datasub_provider_automatic_routing(p_provider_id uuid,p_enabled boolean,p_minimum_balance numeric default null) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ declare p public.datasub_providers%rowtype; m jsonb; begin if not (private.is_admin(auth.uid()) or private.has_product_access(auth.uid(),'datasub','manage')) then raise exception 'Permission denied'; end if; select * into p from public.datasub_providers where id=p_provider_id for update; if p.id is null then raise exception 'Provider not found'; end if; m=coalesce(p.metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('manual_enabled',p_enabled); if p_minimum_balance is not null then m=m||jsonb_build_object('minimum_balance',greatest(0,p_minimum_balance)); end if; update public.datasub_providers set metadata=m,is_active=case when not p_enabled then false else is_active end,updated_at=now() where id=p.id; return jsonb_build_object('provider_id',p.id,'automatic_routing_enabled',p_enabled,'minimum_balance',coalesce((m->>'minimum_balance')::numeric,0)); end $$; revoke all on function public.set_datasub_provider_automatic_routing(uuid,boolean,numeric) from public,anon; grant execute on function public.set_datasub_provider_automatic_routing(uuid,boolean,numeric) to authenticated;

statements: create or replace function public.grade_academy_assignment_submission(p_submission_id uuid,p_score numeric,p_feedback text default null) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ declare s public.academy_assignment_submissions%rowtype; a public.academy_assignments%rowtype; allowed boolean:=false; begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if; select * into s from public.academy_assignment_submissions where id=p_submission_id for update; if s.id is null then raise exception 'Submission not found'; end if; select * into a from public.academy_assignments where id=s.assignment_id; if a.id is null then raise exception 'Assignment not found'; end if; if private.is_admin(array['super_admin'::public.user_role]) then allowed:=true; else select exists(select 1 from public.academy_instructors i left join public.academy_cohort_instructors ci on ci.instructor_id=i.id where i.user_id=auth.uid() and i.is_active and (a.cohort_id is null or ci.cohort_id=a.cohort_id)) into allowed; end if; if not allowed then raise exception 'Instructor access required'; end if; if p_score<0 or p_score>a.max_score then raise exception 'Score must be between 0 and assignment maximum'; end if; update public.academy_assignment_submissions set score=p_score,feedback=nullif(trim(p_feedback),''),status='graded',graded_at=now(),graded_by=auth.uid(),updated_at=now() where id=s.id; end $$; revoke all on function public.grade_academy_assignment_submission(uuid,numeric,text) from public,anon; grant execute on function public.grade_academy_assignment_submission(uuid,numeric,text) to authenticated;
